player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu ya kuhamia si sahihi. Tumia fomu '[X 4]' au '[O 2]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inomero y'urupapuro itabereye: {cell}. Itegerezwa kuba iri hagati ya 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} alitumia alama yake ({mark}) kwenye seli {cell}
